changed.title: Table 1a, 5 by 5, mask 16124928: represented by an AND/OR circuit of fan-in two with at most 6 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 5 => (16124928 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 6
changed.unlocks: Practice on the measure: an exact AND/OR value or a held ceiling on a 5 by 5 graph with an empty line; a floor here opens a saving unit with NOT gates.
changed.sketch: We hold a circuit of 7 gates, the least of three plain forms (by rows, by columns, full lines taken out at the start); we hold none of 6; this is a search. Practice on the measure; a floor here opens a saving unit. This graph has an empty row or column; on the promise its wire can still be lit.
